name: Pool words the five-letter ring let onto boards, vetted one by one
WHY_THIS_FILE_EXISTS: The wheel cap came down from 8 tiles to 7, which put 22 levels over. Most of them can be
divided into two smaller levels instead of losing a word, but a level needs three words,
and several of the 22 had only three or four to start with. Those need a word from outside.
tools/vocabulary.py holds 541 words and 201 are on no board, so words are not scarce. What
is scarce is words that pass the curriculum's own test: a picture could replace the gloss.
The pool is a bare word list with no glosses, so a borrowed word arrives with nothing an
illustrator could work from - which is why every one is written out here with its gloss
`allow` is what tools/refit.py may put on a board. `refuse` is everything else it asked for,
with the reason, so the same word is not proposed again in six months. Adjectives and
abstract nouns are refused on the same grounds the rest of the curriculum refuses them: a
level of বড় / সরু / নরম / কঠিন teaches the letter and gives a child nothing to picture.

কবিতা.flag: draw an open book of verse

বেগুনি.flag: the colour, not the বেগুনি fritter

শীত.flag: draw a shawl and mist, not a thermometer

refuse.মাসি: West Bengal form; this game says খালা. Already in vocabulary.py's rejects
refuse.বড়: adjective: nothing to draw that is not a comparison
refuse.কম: abstract quantity, and a fragment a child meets as a verb ending
refuse.কর: reads as the imperative of করা, which is already on a board
refuse.সকল: abstract: all, and the more literary of the two
refuse.সমতল: abstract: level ground, and a geography register
refuse.হৃদয়: the heart as feeling, not the organ - abstract
refuse.বস: reads as the imperative of বসা, which is allowed instead
refuse.গৃহ: Sanskritic and literary; বাড়ি is the word a child uses, and it is on a board
refuse.বসন্ত: a season, and also the word for smallpox - not for a child's board
refuse.বর্ষাকাল: the rainy season: বর্ষা already carries this and is on a board
refuse.আষাঢ়: a month of the Bengali calendar; no picture shows it
refuse.রাস্তাঘাট: a plural abstraction: streets in general
refuse.চিঠিপত্র: a plural abstraction: correspondence. চিঠি is the drawable one and is on a board
refuse.কমলা: already set as a puzzle on another level
refuse.জল: West Bengal form; this game says পানি
refuse.জুতো: West Bengal form; Bangladesh says জুতা
refuse.সুতো: West Bengal form, and সুতা is already on a board
refuse.ঔষধ: the same word as ওষুধ, which is already on a board
refuse.নৃত্য: Sanskritic; নাচ is the word a child uses and it is on a board
refuse.উত্তর: abstract: north, and also an answer
refuse.মূল: ambiguous: a root, but also an origin. মূলা the radish is allowed instead
